text:
mike: Hey — opened PR #2789 with a tiny refactor around kvcache key naming and ran gofmt. Mostly mechanical but flagged by linter. Need 1 more approval before I merge. Ping @sara @jen for a quick look.

sara: taking a quick look now. saw one naming nit: `cacheKey` vs `cache_key` in a test helper — we usually use camelCase in go code, so `cacheKey` is fine, but in that helper it mixes snake_case, can you normalize?

jen: also please run `go vet` and `golangci-lint run` locally — CI caught a nil-check warning on the store path in my run.

mike: thanks. I updated the helper to camelCase and added an explicit nil check in store.go. pushing a fix in a sec. here's the commands I used: ```git checkout pr/2789 && git pull origin pr/2789 && git commit -am "kvcache: normalize test helper name, add nil check" && git push --force```

ci-bot: build/ci — PR #2789: tests failed on commit 9a7f2c. failing job: unit-tests (logs: https://ci.internal/reports/2789/unit-tests)

mike: fixed the nil-check, repushed. CI should rerun.

ci-bot: build/ci — PR #2789: all checks passed ✅ (unit-tests, lint, integration).

jen: lgtm from me — tiny change, tests look good. :thumbsup:

rajesh: quick nit: in kvcache comments you updated, could you expand the comment on `prefetchThreshold` to clarify units (tokens vs bytes)? we've had confusion there before. if you want me to follow-up I can file a tiny doc patch, otherwise a one-line comment is fine.

mike: good call — added a one-line clarifying comment (prefetchThreshold is in tokens). pushed.

sara: looks clean now. no blocking items from my side. schedule-wise, want to land this in tomorrow's merge window (09:00 PST) — can you hold off merging until then so we don't disrupt release candidates?

mike: yup will wait for the 09:00 PST merge slot and then merge once I have CI green and at least 1 approval (jen already approved). thanks y'all.

jen: sounds good.

mike: merge done at 09:02 PST — thanks everyone, :tada:.

ci-bot: build/ci — PR #2789 merged into main by mike (commit 3b2f1a).
